title: The Late Parish
author: Emrys Almeida
blurb: Casper Eriksen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
